title: Frame Timing, Jank, and Compose Recomposition Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies frame timing, jank, and compose recomposition?
options: Tie Compose or rendering work to missed frame evidence and optimise the responsible phase without breaking state correctness.
Use method tracing for final frame metrics
Assume main thread is every jank cause
questions.answer: Tie Compose or rendering work to missed frame evidence and optimise the responsible phase without breaking state correctness.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A recomposed composable necessarily causes a missed frame.
questions.explanation: Counting every recomposition as wasted work encourages incorrect remember/stability changes even when frames meet deadlines and state should update.

questions.prompt: Why does display refresh rate matter to jank analysis?
questions.answer: Higher refresh rates provide a smaller time budget before each frame deadline.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
